units.text: INT. PLANETARIUM - DOME THEATRE - NIGHT
Rows of reclined seats.
The domed ceiling glows with a frozen field of stars.
A beam of red light from the projector sweeps slowly across the constellation Orion.
INSPECTOR LINDIWE DUBE (50s, trench coat, notebook) stands at the base of the control console.
Beside her, FERDINAND ACHEBE-LARSEN (60s, planetarium director, bow tie) wrings his hands.
Over by the exit door, ROLAND PIKE (30s, security guard, flashlight, mint-green uniform) shifts from foot to foot.
Slumped across the console under a blanket lies the body of a night technician.
Mr. Achebe-Larsen, when did you find her?
units.name: DUBE

units.text: At closing. Around ten.
units.name: FERDINAND

units.text: And you touched nothing?
units.name: DUBE

units.text: Nothing. I only draped the blanket.
units.name: FERDINAND

units.text: That is touching something.
units.name: DUBE

units.text: Inspector, I could not leave her exposed.
units.name: FERDINAND

units.text: Dube kneels.
Lifts the blanket.
Studies the hands, the collar, the tiny bruise at the base of the neck.
She glances at the console, then up at the false stars.
Orion is upside down.
units.name: DUBE

units.text: It is?
units.name: FERDINAND

units.text: The projector is calibrated for the southern sky. Someone changed it.
units.name: DUBE

units.text: Ferdinand's hands tremble.
He steps back, bumping a seat.
Maud never touched the settings. She told me that herself, Mr. Ferdinand.
units.name: ROLAND

units.text: Roland, please.
units.name: FERDINAND

units.text: Mr. Pike. You were on the door tonight?
units.name: DUBE

units.text: Yes, ma'am. I signed everyone out. Only Mr. Ferdinand and Maud were left.
units.name: ROLAND

units.text: Ferdinand and Roland look at each other.
Neither blinks.
Dube looks from one to the other and writes one line, underlines it twice.
Her notebook slips.
Dube and Roland both stoop to catch it, collide, freeze, both apologize at once.
Sorry.
units.name: DUBE

units.text: My fault entirely.
units.name: ROLAND

units.text: She retrieves it herself.
Mr. Achebe-Larsen, who has keys to the projector room?
units.name: DUBE

units.text: Only myself and Maud.
units.name: FERDINAND

units.text: Then I suggest you tell me where you were at nine fifteen.
units.name: DUBE

units.text: The projector hums.
A shooting star arcs across the dome, perfectly timed, perfectly empty.
Inspector. Is that a question?
units.name: FERDINAND

units.text: It is the only one I have left.
units.name: DUBE
